title: Qashtāla ends its war in Arghūn and turns its armies south against the Marīnids

Four Marīnid armies of some 2,000 men each have crossed the Strait: one at Qādis and two at Walba on the Castilian coast, which the court watches closely, and one at al-Mariyya, which was thrown back into the sea
source: Trent's account (by 3 February 1361; the battle at al-Mariyya isn't dated yet)
